public_rationale: The forecast's condition is unverified. A reported funding round shows that financing continued in part of the ecosystem, but it cannot define conditions for every relevant startup. The search also did not establish the separate claim that most compute customers are unprofitable competitors of OpenAI and Anthropic. Existing demand does not refute a prediction about demand after a funding cutoff.
limitations: The funding evidence is a news report based on a company interview.
A single funding round is not a market-wide funding measure.
Customer counts cannot be inferred from spending concentration.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Once venture funding stops, nobody will want AI compute capacity, because most customers are unprofitable AI startups.

statement.excerpt: In addition, the vast majority of customers for AI compute are unprofitable AI startups that want to compete with OpenAI and Anthropic, meaning that once the venture spigot turns off, nobody will want it.

from_speaker: the vast majority of customers for AI compute
want to compete with OpenAI and Anthropic
once the venture spigot turns off
our_interpretation: Read the condition as a broad cessation of venture financing for the relevant AI startup customers, not a slowdown or isolated failed fundraising.
Read 'nobody will want it' as the disappearance of meaningful commercial demand for the AI compute capacity discussed. Do not require literally zero experimental use.
Read 'majority of customers' as customer count, because no spending-weighted or capacity-weighted measure is supplied.

The current customer-composition premise is distinct from the conditional outcome. Use the latest completed calendar quarter before publication, July through September 2026, when seeking evidence for that premise.
No deadline or waiting period after the financing cutoff is supplied.
criteria.support_condition: After a verified broad financing cutoff for the relevant customers, contracts, utilization and purchasing records establish that meaningful commercial demand for the capacity disappears. A separate customer census must establish the asserted current composition.
criteria.contradiction_condition: After that financing cutoff, sustained material paid use or new purchases demonstrate continuing commercial demand for the capacity.
